agents-md-check.00b8e1df6074: The width a report's where column falls back to when it has no rows: with no rows nothing is padded to it, so any number there prints the same report.

all-passages.32622b64e069: The cap that stands for every passage when no --top is given: 10**9 and 11**9 both exceed any pile's passages, so either serves the same list.

coming-up.059bb44076f5: The kernel's dates are exactly eight characters, so d[6:9] is d[6:8].

flashcards.02e79d23c4db: `last` is None only on a card's first review, when `card` is None too and step() returns before it reads `days`, so the days passed there (0 or 1) change no result.

land.0d2be111d6b6: The width a report's where column falls back to when it has no rows: with no rows nothing is padded to it, so any number there prints the same report.

lesson-time.05dbd1b2d85d: said_at's starting value is never read: a plan that states its time sets said_at to that line, and one that states none is skipped or shown as from --period, so the starting 0 changes no result.

misquote.101d4093cf32: The where column's cap: every row of misquote's report has the same place, the closest passage, so the column is that place's width whatever the cap, and no row is padded.

new-kinds.0cbcf08d2031: The size given a file that can't be looked at: it only has to be past TRY_BYTES so the file is never tried, and TRY_BYTES + 1 or + 2 are both past it, so the trial is the same.

play-bureau.06401a082af5: The seed a Session falls back to when none is given: the default is never used, since every game is built with the seed its record holds, so any number there plays the same.

red-on-main.3fe0b0e60f12: The width a report's where column falls back to when it has no rows: with no rows nothing is padded to it, so any number there prints the same report.

removed.2dc6bc910193: The block a file is read in to fingerprint it: any size reads every byte once, so the SHA-256 and the size on the row are the same.

restack-open.2007109c09fd: How much of git's own message a refusal quotes: any length names the same git failure, and only a message longer than 200 characters would read differently.

three-two-one.1857a4e63913: box_rows starts at 0 only to exist before the loop; the box is always the first copy parsed and sets it before any other copy is compared, so the starting number never reaches a comparison.

todo.08807890b7cc: The width a report's where column falls back to when it has no rows: with no rows nothing is padded to it, so any number there prints the same report.

transcript-redact.2f8474d895a6: split("@", 1)[1] takes the text after an email's one @; the email shape allows a single @, so any maxsplit of at least 1 gives the same domain.

typosquat.0b021f6deb3f: src is used only via len(src)!=1; with the two-name list, flipping 'o in opts' to 'o not in opts' swaps which names land in src but leaves that length 0/1/2 the same for every command line, so the refuse/pass decision is unchanged.

unpinned.0c539d7b4204: Which of --box and --from were given: of two options, exactly one given and exactly one not given are the same test, and the source is read from the options themselves after.

why-not.0a2392676768: The 1 caps how many times "A passage" is made lower case in the line that says how many words a passage has to hold; that line holds the phrase once, so any cap of one or more gives the same words.
